sql: select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)||'-'||split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) ev, count(*) ticks,  min(captured_at) first_tick, max(captured_at) last_tick,  min(captured_at + hours_to_expiration*interval '1 hour') exp_min,  max(captured_at + hours_to_expiration*interval '1 hour') exp_max,  min(captured_at + hours_to_close*interval '1 hour') close_min from mmsell_candidate_ticks where split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) in ('26OCT11MINNO','26OCT11SFSEA','26OCT12BALATL','26OCT04NEBUF','26OCT05ATLNO','26SEP27CARCLE')   and split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)='KXNFLTOTAL' group by 1 order by 1
